rules.seoDescription: Explore Muzicalist's rules and recommendations for profiles, artistic content, interactions, bookings and community safety.
rules.title: Muzicalist Rules
rules.intro: Rules and recommendations for keeping Muzicalist professional, authentic and useful for everyone.

photo.title: 1. Profile photo
photo.body: Choose a recent, clear, high-quality profile photo in which you or your band are easy to recognize. Someone viewing it should immediately understand who you are and what you do as a musical artist.
photo.examples: Recommended examples: singers and soloists can use a clear portrait or performance photo; DJs can appear at the decks or in a professional portrait; instrumentalists can appear with their main instrument; bands can use a current group photo showing their members clearly.
photo.avoid: Avoid blurry, dark, distant, excessively edited, unrelated or misleading images. Logos, posters, flyers and text-heavy graphics are not recommended. Individual profiles should avoid unclear group photos, while group photos are appropriate for band profiles.
photo.visibility: This matters because your photo represents you in search results, artist categories, country and region pages, rankings, feeds and your public profile.
photo.notice: These are professional recommendations, not new technical upload restrictions or automatic moderation. The existing requirement to provide a profile photo during artist registration remains unchanged.

realInfo.title: 2. Profile information must be genuine
realInfo.body: Use your real stage identity and accurate information about your activity, experience, location, specialization, services and availability. Do not invent credentials, reviews, collaborations or achievements.

representativePhoto.title: 3. Use a photo that represents your category
representativePhoto.body: Your main image should reflect your musical role. A singer, DJ, instrumentalist or band should be visually identifiable through a suitable portrait, performance setting, instrument or current group image.

recognizablePhoto.title: 4. The artist must be clearly identifiable
recognizablePhoto.body: Choose framing, lighting and image quality that make the artist easy to identify. Avoid images where faces are obscured, the subject is too distant or effects significantly alter the artist's appearance.

relevant.title: 1. Publish only content relevant to your musical activity
relevant.body: Share performances, rehearsals, releases, projects, behind-the-scenes moments and professional updates connected to your musical work. Keep unrelated personal or commercial content off your artist presence.

copyright.title: 2. Respect copyright
copyright.body: Only upload or share music, images and videos you own or are authorized to use. Credit collaborators and rights holders whenever attribution is required.

attribution.title: 3. Do not publish material attributed to another artist
attribution.body: Never present another artist's recording, image, performance or achievement as your own. Clearly identify covers, collaborations, licensed material and guest appearances.

qualityMedia.title: 4. Use relevant, high-quality photos and videos
qualityMedia.body: Choose media that clearly presents your work and can be viewed or heard comfortably. Avoid heavily compressed, misleading, duplicated or unrelated material that does not help people understand your artistic activity.

postRules.title: 1. Rules for posts
postRules.body: Use posts to share authentic updates and artistic content with your community. Keep descriptions accurate, media relevant and any people or collaborators properly represented.

announcementRules.title: 2. Rules for announcements
announcementRules.body: Announcements should describe a genuine event opportunity with clear requirements, location, date, budget and contact context where applicable. Update or remove information that is no longer current.

promotionRules.title: 3. Rules for promotions
promotionRules.body: Promotions must accurately describe the artist, service, event or offer being promoted. Do not use false urgency, fabricated results, hidden conditions or misleading comparisons.

avoidContent.title: 4. Content to avoid
avoidContent.body: Avoid repeated posts, deceptive claims, unrelated advertising, engagement bait, copied material, abusive language, unsafe links and content intended mainly to manipulate visibility or contact users without a legitimate purpose.

respect.title: 1. Respect other users and artists
respect.body: Communicate professionally even when you disagree. Do not insult, threaten, discriminate against or publicly shame another member of the community.

harassment.title: 2. Do not harass others or abuse messaging
harassment.body: Do not send unwanted repeated messages, sexual or threatening content, pressure users for a response or continue contacting someone who has clearly asked you to stop.

spam.title: 3. Do not use the platform for spam
spam.body: Avoid mass messaging, repeated solicitations, irrelevant links, automated outreach and identical promotional messages sent without a legitimate connection to the recipient.

misleading.title: 4. Do not mislead other users
misleading.body: Be honest about your identity, availability, experience, pricing and intentions. Do not conceal important conditions or make promises you cannot reasonably fulfill.

confirmed.title: 1. Honor confirmed bookings
confirmed.body: Treat an accepted booking as a professional commitment. Keep the agreed date available and notify the other party promptly if an exceptional issue may affect the event.

intent.title: 2. Do not accept bookings you do not intend to honor
intent.body: Accept only requests you can reasonably fulfill. Do not hold dates speculatively, accept conflicting commitments or use acceptance only to obtain contact details.

eventInfo.title: 3. Provide accurate event information
eventInfo.body: Share correct details about the date, time, location, format, duration, audience, equipment, access requirements and budget so both parties can make informed decisions.

agreements.title: 4. Respect communication and agreements made through the platform
agreements.body: Keep messages clear and professional, confirm important changes and honor the scope, timing and payment terms agreed through Muzicalist unless both parties agree to revise them.

prohibited.title: 1. Prohibited content
prohibited.body: Do not publish illegal, threatening, hateful, sexually exploitative, violent or privacy-violating material, dangerous instructions or content that targets people based on protected characteristics.

abuse.title: 2. Spam and abusive behavior
abuse.body: Coordinated disruption, repeated unwanted promotion, manipulation of reactions or reviews, intimidation and attempts to overwhelm platform features are not acceptable.

impersonation.title: 3. Impersonation
impersonation.body: Do not pretend to be another artist, user, company or representative. Fan, tribute and management accounts must describe their relationship clearly and must not create confusion about identity.

fraud.title: 4. Fraud and scam attempts
fraud.body: Do not request deceptive payments, use false booking offers, send phishing links, misrepresent services or attempt to obtain money, credentials or personal information through manipulation.
